title: Design system
subtitle: Tokens and components of Agentic Workstation. Visible in development builds only.

specimens.buttonsTouchWrap: Touch-sized buttons: a long label wraps in a narrow column

specimens.cardFit: Card that fits its place: the text scrolls, the buttons stay in view
specimens.modalTouch: Modal with a touch-sized close button (phone)
specimens.fileIcons: File icons - by name, extension and parent folder; open folders
specimens.fileIconsSmall: Small file icons - next to text and in chips
specimens.textArea: Multi-line field: grows with the text, with error, disabled
specimens.spinner: Spinner: accent, neutral and warning; sm, md and around a sign
specimens.tabStrip: Conversation tabs - groups, forks, a cut name, a call
specimens.iconPlaque: Icon plaque: tones, md and lg, muted
specimens.page: Page header and sections, help behind ?
specimens.pageToolbar: Page header with tabs and filters below the line
specimens.barChart: Bar chart: one series, the tallest bar labeled
specimens.barChartGrouped: Bar chart: two series side by side
specimens.barChartEmpty: Bar chart: nothing in the period
specimens.calendarHeatmapSparse: Calendar heatmap: second tone, few active days
specimens.shareBarRanked: Share bar as a ranking row, and empty
